content.identity_summary: A product-focused developer who blends React expertise, full-stack engineering, AI-driven features, and a strong problem-solving mindset to build meaningful and scalable digital products.

projects.name: BlogYam — AI-Powered Blogging Platform
projects.tagline: Full-stack community blog with AI-powered reading assistance, in-app meme generation, daily quotes, and an Admin-curated nomination engine.
projects.problem: Generic blogs are passive content dumps — no discovery logic, no community accountability, and no creative tools. Writers publish into a void without quality signals or deep content interaction for readers.
projects.approach: Integrated an OpenRouter-powered AI assistant (accessing top-tier LLMs) that provides contextual summaries and explains blog content; built an in-app meme generator and daily quotes engine for creative expression; and implemented a weekly nomination system where the Admin curates 'Supreme' and 'Elite' picks.
projects.tech: React.js, Vite, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, JWT, OpenRouter API
projects.challenge: Architecting a secure, role-based ecosystem where the Admin can efficiently review community nominations and promote content while ensuring the AI enhancements (summaries/explanations) stay contextual and helpful.
projects.outcome: Shipped a fully moderated publishing ecosystem with role-based dashboards, AI-driven content summarization, Admin-led quality curation ('Supreme/Elite'), interactive commenting, daily quotes, and a meme generator.

projects.name: Preseejan — Precision Watch Ecommerce
projects.tagline: Full-stack luxury watch platform with biometric wrist-fit simulation, a weighted AI recommendation engine, and RSA-encrypted authentication.
projects.problem: Buying a watch online is nothing like buying a t-shirt — but every e-commerce template treats it the same. Shoppers have no sizing guidance, no lifestyle context, and no trust signals. They buy wrong, or don't buy at all.
projects.approach: Engineered three custom systems on top of a MERN backend: a WristFit™ simulator that maps wrist circumference to ideal dial diameter with horology-backed reasoning; a 3-step quiz feeding a weighted scoring API (+30 wrist fit / +40 usage context / +30 style alignment, ≥60 to surface); and occasion-first Mongoose queries curating 'office', 'luxury', 'gifting', and 'sport' collections server-side.
projects.tech: React 18, Vite, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express v5, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose, JWT (httpOnly Cookie), HMAC-SHA256, RSA-OAEP, Web Crypto API, Nodemailer
projects.challenge: The hardest problem was the auth pipeline: passwords are RSA-OAEP encrypted in-browser via the Web Crypto API before transmission, decrypted server-side, then re-hashed with HMAC-SHA256 + a random 16-byte salt — while also auto-migrating legacy bcrypt hashes on next login without breaking existing accounts.
projects.outcome: Shipped a production-grade luxury commerce platform: WristFit simulator, recommendation engine with graceful client-side fallback, occasion collections, side-by-side watch comparison, newsletter via Nodemailer, and full dark/light mode — all under a zero-plain-text-password auth layer.

projects.name: LinkSafe — Security-First URL Shortener
projects.tagline: Production-grade MERN SaaS that transforms links into branded, trackable, security-audited short URLs.
projects.problem: Most URL shorteners are dumb redirectors — they shorten and forget, expose raw destinations immediately, and store passwords in plain text with zero traffic insight.
projects.approach: Built a full SaaS intelligence layer: Safe Preview Page shows destination domain + HTTPS status before navigating, dual-mode analytics dashboard (global + per-link), HttpOnly JWT cookies, HMAC-SHA256 hashing, rate limiting, and custom branded aliases.
projects.tech: React 18, Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, Recharts, JWT, Helmet, nanoid, qrcode
projects.challenge: Designing a security-first system where every redirect passes through a preview interceptor, tokens never touch JavaScript (HttpOnly cookies), and the full audit trail is immutably stored in the MongoDB schema.
projects.outcome: Shipped a production-grade SaaS with QR code generation, per-link analytics, custom aliases, and a Security Center auditing HTTPS compliance across all user links.

projects.name: Pokédex — Live Pokémon Explorer
projects.tagline: Fast, responsive browser powered by PokéAPI and concurrent fetch logic.
projects.problem: PokéAPI v2 doesn't return stats in the list endpoint. Fetching 124 Pokémon with metadata normally requires 124 sequential requests, causing an 'API waterfall' that takes 5+ seconds to load.
projects.approach: Implemented a concurrent fetch pattern using `Promise.all()`. This maps 124 individual URL promises and resolves them in one parallel execution, slashing load times by 95% (~200ms). Used SVG 'Dream World' artwork for crisp visuals at any scale.
projects.tech: React 19, Vite 6, PokéAPI v2, CSS Grid (Vanilla)
projects.challenge: Solving the N+1 API request problem on the client-side without a backend proxy, ensuring the UI remains interactive while processing over 100 parallel HTTP responses and mapping high-resolution SVG sprites.
projects.outcome: Achieved a near-instant Pokédex with real-time, zero-latency search over in-memory data, high-quality SVG rendering, and a fully responsive grid matching 124 unique data entries.
